findings.title: Residual-digit scan still false-fires on independent neighbouring facts outside the finite role mask (introduced in range)
findings.evidence: In _has_unlocated_ratio_number the delta exemption is gated on the unit token: `if unit[1] == "个百分点" and delta: continue`. For the input `2026中报含金量为1.588，同比增长12%。` the neighbouring independent fact `12%` matches _RATIO_UNIT `%`, the delta regex `(?:增加|增长|…)\s*(?:了|为|是)?\s*$` matches `同比增长`, but because the unit is `%` and not `个百分点` the branch falls through to `return True`. A correct, fully located answer is therefore downgraded to partial with a false `calculation_value_unlocated`, an unnecessary `〔比率对应关系待核对〕` marker is inserted and the single same-turn repair budget is consumed. The same happens for a bare trailing count that is not in _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX, e.g. `…含金量为1.588，样本量120。`. This trigger path is new in d38dab3f..d46c2c3b (the residual scan and its points-only exemption were added by this range), so it is an introduced false positive, not pre-existing.
findings.recommendation: Pin an explicit residual policy: either extend the delta/comparison exemption to every unit in _RATIO_UNIT (and to unit-less counts preceded by a quantity noun), or restrict the residual trigger to numbers inside the already-bound ratio clause scope, and pin both the positive and negative cases in test_research_delivery_ratio_boundaries.py.

findings.title: Dimension-bearing suffixes outside _RATIO_UNIT make a wrong ratio invisible rather than unlocated
findings.evidence: `bp` appears in _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX but not in _RATIO_UNIT. For `2026中报含金量实际为158.7bp。` _prose_number returns None (the suffix veto fires because number[2] is empty) and _has_unlocated_ratio_number also skips the token via `if not _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX.match(...)`, so no finding of any kind is produced and the implausible value is delivered silently. This is exactly the class the commit closed for `元/元` and `个百分点`; the `bp` hole is pre-existing at d38dab3f and survives the change.
findings.recommendation: Treat dimension-bearing suffixes that cannot carry a ratio (bp, 个, 家, 亿元 when the slot is a ratio) as located-with-implausible-unit, emitting calculation_value_mismatch or calculation_value_unverified instead of silence, and add the bp case as a pinned counterexample.

findings.title: Semicolon continuation is copula-keyed, so a paraphrased continuation still delivers a wrong value with no marker, notice or partial
findings.evidence: _RATIO_CLAUSE joins across `；` only through the lookahead `(?=[*`]*(?:实际|该值|本期|比率)为)`. For `收入可核[E1]，2026中报含金量待核对；该比率为1.587。` the continuation label is `该比率为`, which is outside the four-copula lexicon, so the clause is cut, the withheld slot is not bound to 1.587 and no finding is raised; the same holds for a full stop separator. Pre-existing at baseline, but docs/agent-product-door.md retains the unqualified sentence `已识别比率语境但数值对应不明时，不静默放行`, so the documented contract is broader than the implemented finite lexicon.
findings.recommendation: Either generalise the continuation rule (label-agnostic copula plus ratio noun) or amend the door text to state the finite copula list explicitly, and pin the `该比率为` / full-stop separators as known-out-of-scope negatives so future reviewers can distinguish design from gap.

findings.title: ARL-0004 lead 5 unengaged: repair note never asks for marker removal and raw/stripped marker detection disagree under markup

findings.title: Residual-digit scan still false-fires on independent neighbouring facts outside the finite role mask (introduced in range)
findings.evidence: In _has_unlocated_ratio_number the delta exemption is gated on the unit token: `if unit[1] == "个百分点" and delta: continue`. For the input `2026中报含金量为1.588，同比增长12%。` the neighbouring independent fact `12%` matches _RATIO_UNIT `%`, the delta regex `(?:增加|增长|…)\s*(?:了|为|是)?\s*$` matches `同比增长`, but because the unit is `%` and not `个百分点` the branch falls through to `return True`. A correct, fully located answer is therefore downgraded to partial with a false `calculation_value_unlocated`, an unnecessary `〔比率对应关系待核对〕` marker is inserted and the single same-turn repair budget is consumed. The same happens for a bare trailing count that is not in _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX, e.g. `…含金量为1.588，样本量120。`. The residual scan and its points-only exemption are new in d38dab3f..d46c2c3b, so this is an introduced false positive, not pre-existing.
findings.recommendation: Pin an explicit residual policy: either extend the delta/comparison exemption to every unit in _RATIO_UNIT (and to unit-less counts preceded by a quantity noun), or restrict the residual trigger to numbers inside the already-bound ratio clause scope, and pin both the positive and negative cases in test_research_delivery_ratio_boundaries.py.
